'''Loped VII''' was an object<ref name="RF" /> located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Loped VII was known for its plains.<ref name="RF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Loped VII was first mentioned<ref name="RF" /> in the novel ''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]'', which was written by [[Alex Wheeler]] and released in [[2010]].<ref name="ERC" /> Later, the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the [[Loped system/Legends|Loped star system]], and thereby Loped VII itself, in grid square O-9.<ref name="EAOC" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Rebel Force: Trapped]]'' {{1stm}}
